findings.evidenceJa: 全ての秒針が頂点を指す。
findings.governingReading: Every second hand points to the top as the promised time arrives.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes an audible clock strike and singular clock for the visual convergence of all second hands.

findings.highlight: The only other thing I’m taking is the pendant.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に言われたペンダント一つだけ
findings.governingReading: The only other object is the pendant Rin instructed Shirou to bring.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the pendant but removes Rin’s instruction, weakening its planned relevance.

findings.highlight: I’m also having her stay here because she’s my hope.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤに残ってもらうのは俺の希望でもある
findings.governingReading: Illya remains partly because Shirou himself wishes or requests that she stay.
findings.explanation: The English makes Illya personally embody Shirou’s “hope” instead of expressing his preference that she remain behind.

findings.governingReading: The functions Shirou possesses as a living organism are being stripped away.
findings.explanation: “Human functionality” is unnatural and narrows biological function to a vague category of humanness.

findings.evidenceJa: 少しずつこそぎ落ちている
findings.governingReading: His biological functions are being scraped away little by little.
findings.explanation: The English weakens active, layer-by-layer removal into generic erosion.

findings.governingReading: Illya asks Shirou to return with Sakura and Rin around the time dawn breaks.
findings.explanation: The English turns an approximate dawn homecoming into a deadline before dawn.

findings.evidenceJa: 居間は静まり返っている。
findings.governingReading: The living room is utterly silent.
findings.explanation: The English expands the location from the living room to the entire house, weakening the room-by-room farewell structure.

findings.highlight: A morning scene that was part of my life for a year and a half.
findings.evidenceJa: いつも、この一年半、身近で在り続けてくれた朝の風景
findings.governingReading: It is the morning scene that always remained close to Shirou throughout the last year and a half.
findings.explanation: The English retains the duration but removes the constancy and sustaining closeness of the domestic scene.

findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の背中を追いかけて
findings.governingReading: Shirou pursued Kiritsugu’s receding example or followed in his footsteps through nightly training.
findings.explanation: The English replaces active pursuit of an inherited path with a generalized hope of resemblance.

findings.evidenceJa: 毎夜、無我夢中になって鍛錬をした
findings.governingReading: Every night Shirou trained with complete self-forgetting absorption.
findings.explanation: “Trained hard” preserves effort but removes the single-minded loss of self that characterized the routine.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s face comes to my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の面影だけは明確に蘇る
findings.governingReading: Only Sakura’s lingering image or remembered presence returns with clarity.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the surviving trace of Sakura to her face.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識はもう細切れになりそう
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s consciousness seems on the verge of being chopped into fragments.
findings.explanation: The English changes fragmentation and discontinuity into a gradual fade.

findings.highlight: The ten years in this house are ambiguous in my head.
findings.evidenceJa: 十年間が何もかもあやふやになっている
findings.governingReading: Everything about the ten years spent in the mansion has become uncertain and unstable in memory.
findings.explanation: “Are ambiguous” is nonidiomatic for cognitive deterioration and suggests interpretive ambiguity rather than failing recall.

findings.highlight: Taking a firm grip on my consciousness
findings.evidenceJa: 断線する意識を繋ぎとめて
findings.governingReading: Shirou holds together or tethers a consciousness whose connections are breaking.
findings.explanation: The English removes the recurring broken-wire mechanism and replaces it with a generic metaphor of resolve.

findings.evidenceJa: それを今でも繰り返す。
findings.governingReading: That mutual encouragement or promise is still being repeated even now.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the repetition solely to Shirou and changes an ongoing present pattern into one future act.

findings.highlight: What was that small hope used for?
findings.evidenceJa: 何処に向かう為の、小さな希望だったのだろう。
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks toward what destination that small hope was meant to lead.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the unresolved direction of the hope with a utilitarian question about its use.
